passages.note: The 160 MW Southern Oak site in Camilla finished construction in December 2019 and used LONGi Hi-MO2 bifacial PERC modules with NEXTracker single-axis trackers. The portfolio gives commercial operation in 2020 and lists the site as operating with Georgia Power as counterparty.
